checks.source:
import TransposeFollowup.GraphSeparatorBound
import TransposeFollowup.AdaptiveForestRate

namespace AdaptiveReview
open TransposeFollowup
variable {V : Type*}

def legacySupports (s : PublicStrategy V (fun _ => Bool)) :
    List Bool → List Bool → List (Finset V)
  | _, [] => []
  | h, a :: m => match s h with
    | none => []
    | some q => q.support :: legacySupports s (h ++ [a]) m

theorem supports_preserved (s : PublicStrategy V (fun _ => Bool)) (h m : List Bool) :
    s.querySupports h m = legacySupports s h m := by
  induction m generalizing h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a m ih =>
    cases hs : s h with
    | none => simp [PublicStrategy.querySupports, PublicStrategy.truncate, hs, legacySupports,
        PublicProtocol.querySupports]
    | some q =>
      simpa [PublicStrategy.querySupports, PublicStrategy.truncate, hs, legacySupports,
        PublicProtocol.querySupports] using congrArg (List.cons q.support) (ih (h ++ [a]))

def legacyGraph (s : PublicStrategy V (fun _ => Bool)) (h m : List Bool) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj v w := v ≠ w ∧ ∃ S ∈ legacySupports s h m, v ∈ S ∧ w ∈ S
  symm := ⟨fun _ _ ⟨hne, S, hs, hv, hw⟩ => ⟨hne.symm, S, hs, hw, hv⟩⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩

theorem graph_preserved (s : PublicStrategy V (fun _ => Bool)) (h m : List Bool) :
    s.bankInteractionGraph h m = legacyGraph s h m := by
  ext v w
  simp only [PublicStrategy.bankInteractionGraph, PublicProtocol.interactionGraph, legacyGraph]
  rw [← PublicStrategy.querySupports, supports_preserved]

#print axioms supports_preserved
#print axioms graph_preserved
#print axioms TransposeFollowup.PublicStrategy.truncate_querySupports_of_length
#print axioms TransposeFollowup.PublicStrategy.truncate_bankInteractionGraph_of_length
#print axioms TransposeFollowup.fullFiber_expected_cost_of_leaf_cost
#print axioms TransposeFollowup.fullFiber_expected_cost
#print axioms TransposeFollowup.HelperGapBankStrategy.forest_expected_length_of_state_range
#print axioms TransposeFollowup.AdaptiveForestLaw.budget
#print axioms TransposeFollowup.AdaptiveForestLaw.logarithmic_logarithmic_rate
end AdaptiveReview
